explication: mod-playerbots adds player-like characters to an AzerothCore MMO server. A player or bot master issues chat commands, or the game world generates events; the AI engine evaluates triggers and active strategies, queues actions, and the bot responds in-world. Strategies cover combat, quests, travel, group play, and battlegrounds, while random bots simulate everyday player activity. The tree and sampled excerpts establish the engine’s trigger/action loop and selected integrations; several major feature areas are represented by their existing directories because their implementations were not sampled.
